messages:
Elliot (AE): Heads up — Ben's team re-prioritized the POC. Top priority now is low tail latency (95th/99th) for short queries (<128 tokens) AND BYO-KMS for embeddings. They still want reranking later. Can SEs/SREs weigh in on timeline & pricing impact?

Priya (Solutions Eng): Short answer: BYO-KMS implies either Private deployment or Dedicated with a KMS proxy. That adds infra onboarding (~1–2w) plus security review. For latency SLOs we can hit targets with Dedicated + tuned batching, but need perf evals on a 128-token mix.

Marco (SRE): We can spin a canary on Dedicated smallest pool, but current Dedicated capacity is booked for next ~10 days. If they want start-in-2w, we'd have to provision burst capacity or preempt other work -> cost +~25%.

Tina (Security): BYO-KMS also needs key-wrapping verification, TLS mutual auth, and audit-log plumbing. For HIPAA we need BAA signed and proof of KMS key lifecycle. Please confirm KMS provider (AWS/GCP/Hashi).

Ben (Customer): We're on AWS KMS. HIPAA required. Timeline hard cap is 4 weeks. Budget preference for the trial is < $25k/mo.

Priya (Solutions Eng): Tradeoffs to meet 4w: narrow eval to 128-token queries only, run quantized model variant (4-bit) to reduce infra, and postpone reranking. Proposed success criteria:
- 95th latency < 150ms for <128-token queries
- p99 latency < 300ms (if achievable)
- accuracy delta <= 2% vs your baseline prompts
- embeddings throughput >= 1500/s (batched)
- BYO-KMS integrated end-to-end with audit logs

Elliot (AE): @Ben ok with those metrics?

Ben (Customer): Agree to metrics. Dropping rerank for now is fine.

Priya (Solutions Eng): Also suggested mitigation: enable prefix/KV caching and aggressive small-batch config. Example quick config for a Dedicated canary: 

```json
{
  "deployment": "dedicated-canary",
  "instance_type": "A100-80GB",
  "replicas": 2,
  "concurrency_per_replica": 8,
  "quantize": "q4_0",
  "kms_integration": "aws-kms",
  "kv_cache": true
}
```

Marco (SRE): Note: KV cache requires app-level hooking (prefix keys) — engineering effort estimate 3 days if they can send a sample traffic hook. Also default concurrent connections allowed without extra provisioning is 50; we should size if they need more.

deploy-bot: Created tickets INF-2042 (dedicated-canary provisioning) and INF-2043 (KMS integration path).

Tina (Security): I'll own the security questionnaire. Send SOW + KMS artifacts (ARNs, key policy) and I'll triage. Expect ~3 business days once we have KMS details.

Priya (Solutions Eng): Action items (owners & ETA):
- Perf eval with 128-token prompt set (Priya) — 10 business days
- Reserve burst capacity / provision canary (Marco) — 3 business days to confirm availability
- Security KMS path & questionnaire (Tina) — 2–3 business days after artifacts
- Confirm trial budget & constraints (Elliot) — today
- Customer to upload prompt set and sample traffic (Ben) — ASAP

Ben (Customer): Uploading prompt set now: https://redwood.example/drive/link — will include sample traffic distribution.

Elliot (AE): Great — reconvene Fri EOD for a status sync. Will circulate calendar invite. :thumbsup: 

Priya (Solutions Eng): One more note — if budget + timeline tight, we can offer a focused hosted path (no BYO-KMS) to prove perf fast, then shift to BYO-KMS for phase 2. But Ben already stated HIPAA/BYO-KMS required, so likely phase 1 must include KMS.

Marco (SRE): Acknowledged. I'll check capacity and comment in INF-2042.

Tina (Security): Ping me the SOW when ready.

Elliot (AE): Thanks all — tracking in the ticket thread.
